name: youtube-captions-flashdata
description: Get existing YouTube captions with timed segments. Selects uploader-provided captions by default. Uses FlashData.

FLASHDATA_API_KEY.title: FlashData API key
FLASHDATA_API_KEY.description: FlashData API key from https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys with youtube_captions enabled. Data calls use paid Credits; pricing and job reads are free.
